violation_type.title: Children Younger Than 5 - Policies Address Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §744.2003(2))
violation_type.short_title: Children Younger Than 5 - Policies Address Promotion of Physical Activity
violation_type.typical_finding: While reviewing files it was discovered the following information was missing from operational policies: (2) Have written policies that address the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that are consistent with this division.  (C)The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation  (E)The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities  (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions
